items.source: spec to add headers or perform the exchange
items.translation: 无法添加标题或执行交换。

items.source: If a UriBuilderFactory was configured for the client (for example, with a base URI) it will be used to expand the URI template.
items.translation: 如果已为客户端配置了 `UriBuilderFactory`（例如，带有基础 URI），则它将用于扩展 URI 模板。

items.source: Build the URI for the request with a UriBuilder obtained through the UriBuilderFactory configured for this client.
items.translation: 使用为此客户端配置的UriBuilderFactory获取的UriBuilder构建请求的 URI。

items.source: Specify the URI for the request using a URI template and URI variables.
items.translation: 使用 URI 模板和 URI 变量指定请求的 URI。

items.source: If a UriBuilderFactory was configured for the client with a base URI, that base URI will not be applied to the supplied java.net.URI. If you wish to have a base URI applied to a java.net.URI you must invoke either uri(String, Object...) or uri(String, Map) — for example, uri(myUri.toString()).
items.translation: 如果客户端已配置了带有基础 URI 的UriBuilderFactory，则该基础 URI 将不会应用于提供的java.net.URI。如果您希望将基础 URI 应用于java.net.URI，则必须调用uri(String, Object...)或uri(String, Map)——例如，uri(myUri.toString())。

items.source: Specify the URI using an absolute, fully constructed URI.
items.translation: 使用绝对且完全构建的URI指定 URI。

items.source: Specification for providing the URI of a request.
items.translation: 提供请求 URI 的规范。

items.source: S - a self reference to the spec type
items.translation: S - 对规范类型的自引用
